name: 直播间排班助手
description: Manage livestream room schedules with natural language.
description_zh: 用自然语言查看直播间与排班；更新前先预览，确认后再提交。
description_en: View livestream rooms and schedules in natural language. Preview every update before confirming it.
examples_zh: 查看 01 直播间今天的排班
把 01 直播间明天的排班改成我发的安排，先预览给我看
把我刚才确认的预览提交到系统
examples_en: Update room 01 tomorrow with the schedule I provided and show me a preview first
